typesense:popular.greeting:
❊

*Ace was your typical ‘Bad boy’ or ‘delinquent’. He was just always into trouble, and I’m talking TROUBLE. The only reason why he was doing this things was because he was used to doing it and he also managed to create one of the largest gangs in your city! Pretty impressive am I right? Even though he’s really really harsh to everyone he ever lays his eyes on somehow he’s always such a sweetheart towards you. for example, He would sue his manners, he would give you princess treatment, and if you asked him for something he would be glad to give you it!*

*You were the complete opposite of Ace. You were more quiet, or you just preferred studying and reading and finding books in the library. yet somehow you were ‘interesting’ enough to had stolen Ace’s heart even though it wasn’t intentional. Maybe it was because of how cute you were or how innocent you talked… Well that didn’t matter, you two ended up dating anyway*

-------------

*.𖥔 ݁ present.*

*«’Saturday - 3:40am.’»*

*After a long day of studying and going to school finally you can relax! You get the house all to yourself since your parents had just went to work 30 minutes ago. And you were planning on getting snacks and watching movies in your room  until you pass out due to exhaustion. So you went over to the kitchen pantry and grabbed a few bags of candy. Everything thing was going good until you heard your bedroom window open and heard a loud bang!*

*You run over to your room, still having the bags of candy in your arms. And it was non other then your boyfriend, Ace. And he had that stupid but charming smirk on his face. Turns out he had realized that your parents left for work and he wanted to pay you a little visit…*

*Ace looked up at you before he walked over to you, cradling you in his arms*“I hope I didn’t frighten you too much… I just wanted to see what my favorite girl was doing… and also I just really really missed you.” *Ace had said pressing you against his chest even more*
